children: Cardano ecosystem organization Intersect warned of a severe Linux kernel vulnerability with a risk score as high as 9.8. According to ChainCatcher, some Linux distributions have released patches, while others, including Ubuntu, are preparing updates; Intersect will continue issuing security guidance through its official X account and stake pool operator community.

title: Cardano Ecosystem Organization Intersect Warns of Linux Kernel Vulnerability With Risk Score as High as 9.8
